Title: Review and accept ADR-0008 to ADR-0015 and the DATA, APPLICATION, TECHNOLOGY principles; decide the telemetry runtime (keep Go, recommended, or Kotlin)
Body:
Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Each ADR accepted, changed or rejected in the card thread
- [ ] Telemetry runtime decided (ADR-0012 item 4, revision 0.2 recommends keeping Go because C-01 is Go); README line of EV_PNC_telemetry follows

- [ ] Counts as one of the six PO gates of I3

Epic: E3 OCPI eMSP core platform and infra
Title: Spike: Kafka 4.x KRaft with Strimzi, durability profile and failure drills
Body:
Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] 3 brokers and 3 dedicated controllers on any Kubernetes (kind or k3d is enough; the Turkey region comes with P1-02)
- [ ] RF 3, min.insync.replicas 2, acks=all, idempotence, unclean election off, auto-create off, rack awareness
- [ ] Drills pass: kill one broker, producers and consumers continue; ISR shrinks and recovers; URP alert fires
- [ ] Strimzi, Kafka, client and Spring Modulith versions pinned and compatible; findings recorded in ADR-0009
- [ ] KIP-848 consumer protocol tested with static membership, or the reason to stay on the classic protocol recorded
- [ ] max.compaction.lag.ms set on compacted topics; a tombstone on a quiet topic is compacted within the bound
- [ ] Decision by 20 Dec: keep Kafka for the pilot or use the Postgres-outbox fallback of ADR-0008
